references.text: The immediate context describing how the earth opened up and swallowed Korah, Dathan, and Abiram along with their families and possessions.
A flashback to Korah's rebellion where the earth opened up and swallowed them, making them a warning sign.
Moses reminds Israel of what the Lord did to Dathan and Abiram when the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them.
The psalm describes how the earth opened up and swallowed Dathan and covered over Abiram's company.
Sheol (the realm of the dead) as a place that swallows people alive, similar to the image in Numbers 16:33.
Sheol widens its throat and opens its mouth without limit – parallel to the image of going down alive into the realm of the dead.
To go down into the grave and disappear from the land of the living, a fate similar to those who went down into Sheol.
